Coordinators and Institutions in Horizon Europe Pillar Two

Revised6 Oct 2026
CORDIS snapshot 7 Aug 20265,281 projects · 84,755 participations
ProgrammeHorizon Europe · Pillar Two

Every signed Horizon Europe Pillar Two grant from 2021 to the CORDIS snapshot of 7 August 2026, and the European institutions that hold them: who coordinates, who joins, in which clusters and from which countries, with Australian and New Zealand organisations compared and Flinders as a flagged comparator. Funding figures are the European Union contribution recorded against each institution. Rankings list the 9,832 institutions with two or more projects or a coordination; totals count all 25,887. Every figure is computed from the embedded data when the page loads and checked under Method; no external check against CORDIS project pages has been made. The Continue control steps through every page in order; the menus jump.

Coordinators and Institutions in Horizon Europe Pillar Two. Which European institutions hold Horizon Europe Pillar Two grants, how often and in which role, and where Australian, New Zealand and Flinders University records sit among them. Prepared for the Office of the Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Research), Flinders University, for the International Research Plan. Source: CORDIS: EU research projects under Horizon Europe (2021-2027), HORIZON Projects CSV distribution, snapshot released 7 August 2026, with CORDIS reference data; both published by the European Commission on the European Union Open Data Portal. Figures built 15 September 2026; page rebuilt and figures re-checked 6 October 2026. Flinders participations and association dates from The Group of Eight and RMIT in Horizon Europe (CORDIS pages read 11 and 12 September 2026). Institutional data only, no named individuals.
